title: Image Slider, Framer by @benjaminnathan: Introducing the Ticker Effect. A new way to create continuous, looping
notes:
Introducing the Ticker Effect. A new way to create continuous, looping animations in Framer. Add it to any Stack or CMS List, make it draggable, combine it with other Effects, and customize it per Breakpoint. We think you’ll love it. Now in @framer.

Designer: @benjaminnathan. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
